description: This file defines automated actions related to web page interactions, including scrolling, clicking, input simulation, and navigation, using the @antithesishq/bombadil library.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Performs scroll actions (up or down) based on current page content and scroll position.

methods.name: clicks
methods.description: Generates click actions on detected clickable points such as links, buttons, and ARIA roles.

methods.name: inputs
methods.description: Simulates user input in active form elements like text fields, emails, and numbers.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Creates a navigation action to go back if possible.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Creates a navigation action to go forward if possible.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Creates a reload action if the last action was not a reload.

methods.name: navigation
methods.description: Weighted selection among back, forward, and reload actions for navigation.
